rationale: Builds on the reverse recurrent-tail baseline instead of resetting it. The change gives each recurrent tail block a learned interpolation between the final decoder-output anchor and that block's own first-pass activation, so the second pass can reuse block-local information without adding a new large head or changing shapes. This is a structural recurrence edit, not another small control sweep, and it stays compile-stable and byte-cheap for the 600s Mac-mini regime.
title: Per-Block Tail Anchor Recurrence
